about: The secreta of the formulary “20th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: May these sacramental rites, O Lord, we beseech You, be our heavenly medicine and expel evil from our hearts. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
